title: Weekly Pill Organizer 21 Compartments – Morning, Noon and Evening for Seven Days
descriptionHtml:
"Did I take my morning dose?" is a daily question

Three doses a day and seven bottles in the bathroom cabinet – in the end nobody keeps count, and keeping count is exactly the point.

A week filled on Sunday, then all you do is open

Seven daily boxes with three compartments each – morning, noon, evening – in a case with a lid. Fill everything on Sunday. Today's box goes along in your pocket, the rest stay at home, and the answer to the question is visible in the compartment.

Features

  • The answer is visible in the compartment – an empty compartment means the dose is taken
  • Today's box comes along – detach it and put it in your pocket, the rest stay at home
  • 21 compartments filled at once – one refill a week instead of three a day
  • The lid keeps things in order – the boxes stay in place in the case

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
